name: power-meter
description: Estimates the electricity your Claude Code session is using (watt-hours and watts) from the tokens each model response reports

wh_per_1k_output_haiku.title: Haiku: Wh per 1,000 output tokens
wh_per_1k_output_haiku.description: Energy of 1,000 generated tokens on a Haiku-class model, in watt-hours (default 0.3)

wh_per_1k_output_sonnet.title: Sonnet: Wh per 1,000 output tokens
wh_per_1k_output_sonnet.description: Energy of 1,000 generated tokens on a Sonnet-class model, in watt-hours (default 1). Also used for models the plugin cannot classify

wh_per_1k_output_opus.title: Opus: Wh per 1,000 output tokens
wh_per_1k_output_opus.description: Energy of 1,000 generated tokens on an Opus-class model, in watt-hours (default 2)

wh_per_1k_output_fable.title: Fable/Mythos: Wh per 1,000 output tokens
wh_per_1k_output_fable.description: Energy of 1,000 generated tokens on a Fable- or Mythos-class model, in watt-hours (default 3)

input_fraction.title: Uncached input token, as a fraction of an output token
input_fraction.description: How much energy one uncached input token costs relative to one output token (default 0.2)

cache_write_fraction.title: Cache-write token, as a fraction of an output token
cache_write_fraction.description: How much energy one input token written to the prompt cache costs relative to one output token (default 0.2)

cache_read_fraction.title: Cache-read token, as a fraction of an output token
cache_read_fraction.description: How much energy one input token served from the prompt cache costs relative to one output token (default 0.005)

grid_g_co2_per_kwh.title: Grid carbon intensity (g CO2 per kWh)
grid_g_co2_per_kwh.description: Used for the CO2 line of /power. Roughly 400 for the US grid average, lower in the EU (default 400)

show_status_line.title: Show the status line
show_status_line.description: Keep a live energy figure pinned under the prompt (default on). /power works either way
